gradient_gate_applies_to: both roles, every corresponding minibatch, before grad clip
policy_gate_applies_to: fixed original 64 trajectory minibatch after each complete iteration with real optimizer steps
q_gae_gate_applies_to: initial P2a valid legal Q and masked Policy advantage, Critic QLambda/TD1 targets; later errors observed
coverage_rule: actual frozen observations only, both variants have >=10 samples within ratio distance .002 of either 1+/-clip_coef, and at least one clipped and one unclipped; if absent extend to 4 once; no manufactured samples
sequence_data: same original frozen rollout reused; original Trainer, Replay, RNG permutation calls retained and checked against saved A indices
